scope: Fresh uninterrupted rendered scripted main route; not human play or every optional branch. Game runtime unchanged from presentation release.

limits.aim: Programmatic yaw/pitch target selection; not measured human aiming
limits.building: Reach/support/occupancy/unlock placement_report then paid create_piece and visual add; not UI pointer placement
limits.combat: Damage enabled, normal fire input/raycast/rate/reload; no direct enemy health writes
limits.controls: Reached local authorities and normal mechanism durations; scripted reading dwell based on record length
limits.crafting: Production craft authority at physically reached Workshop
limits.limits: Main campaign branch only (Foundry direct, Orchard caretaker, Meridian quiet, relay ending); optional missions/alternate routes need separate coverage. No uncoached comprehension or expected novice skill claim. Scripted read/build decisions underestimate exploratory dwell.
limits.movement: Input forward with collision-checked route planning; no position edits
limits.pacing: Real engine physics; no fixed-fps, time acceleration or manual ticks
limits.salvage: Actual distance-spawned cargo and production hook flight; no direct receive/reward calls
